# UI index: what to use for a need in Helios

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask ui-index` from the `/// Need (group): ...`
doc lines of Helios's crates and of the egui-pop crates in Cargo.lock.
Do not edit: add or change a `Need` line on the item, then run the task
again. A test fails when this file is stale. -->

**Helios makes no widgets.** Before writing any egui call, find the need
here and use what it names: **the Helios preset first** (`helios_ui`,
later `helios_rack`); the egui-pop widget under it only where Helios has
no preset yet. A need missing from this page is a gap to fill in
egui-pop (then a preset here), not a reason to hand-draw it. See
[docs/design/ui-responsibilities.md](design/ui-responsibilities.md).

`ui.*` methods come from egui-pop's `UiPop` trait (`egui_pop::prelude`).
To add an entry, give the public item a doc line
`/// Need (group): a search field.`, a preset using the same words as
the widget it wraps; the group is one of: `text`, `layout`, `action`, `input`, `state`, `status`, `icon`, `help`, `dialog`, `data`, `image`.

egui-pop in the lock: 0.11.0.
Its crates carry no `Need` lines yet: until the next egui-pop bump, see
[egui-pop's own index](https://github.com/quazardous/egui-pop/blob/next/docs/ui-index.md).

## Text and titles

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a heading over a group of fields | **`helios_ui::section(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::section` | A section's header: the theme's section space, its title in the section text role, its description in the muted one. |
| a section title | **`helios_ui::section(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::section` | A section's header: the theme's section space, its title in the section text role, its description in the muted one. |

## Buttons and actions

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a button by tone (primary, danger, quiet) | **`helios_ui::action(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::action` | A button for `kind` of action, labelled `label`: egui-pop's button in the action's tone. |
| the screen's primary or secondary action | **`helios_ui::action(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::action` | A button for `kind` of action, labelled `label`: egui-pop's button in the action's tone. |

## Fields and choices

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a filter box | **`helios_ui::search(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::search` | A search field over `query` for `search`: egui-pop's search input (magnifier, clearable), named and hinted by its scope, as wide as the space given. |
| a search field | **`helios_ui::search(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::search` | A search field over `query` for `search`: egui-pop's search input (magnifier, clearable), named and hinted by its scope, as wide as the space given. |

## Loading, empty and progress

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a place that failed to load, with Retry | **`helios_ui::failed(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::failed` | A place that failed to load: egui-pop's empty state in danger, with `title`, the `reason` and a Retry action. |
| a value or a list still loading | **`helios_ui::loading(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::loading` | What loads, shown in its shape: egui-pop's skeleton, busy for assistive technologies and named "Loading". |
| a value that refreshes, its last value kept meanwhile | **`helios_ui::value(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::value` | The value in egui-pop's late-value cell: a skeleton sized for its kind while pending, the value, the last value with a small spinner while refreshing, the reason with Retry once failed. |
| a value worked out late (a size, a count), with its waiting states | **`helios_ui::value(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::value` | The value in egui-pop's late-value cell: a skeleton sized for its kind while pending, the value, the last value with a small spinner while refreshing, the reason with Retry once failed. |
| an empty state, nothing here yet | **`helios_ui::empty(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::empty` | The empty state of `case`: egui-pop's empty state (icon, title, sentence, action). |
| no results for a search or a filter | **`helios_ui::empty(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::empty` | The empty state of `case`: egui-pop's empty state (icon, title, sentence, action). |
| placeholder shapes while content loads | **`helios_ui::loading(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::loading` | What loads, shown in its shape: egui-pop's skeleton, busy for assistive technologies and named "Loading". |

## Tooltips, hover cards and notices

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a toast, a short notice that fades | **`helios_ui::notify(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::notify` | Raises `text` at `level`: a toast of egui-pop's toasts service. |
